103        private int getUnlockCost() {
104                return 5000;
105        }
106        
107        private boolean canPlayerAffordUnlock() {
108                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
109                int credits = (int) playerFleet.getCargo().getCredits().get();
110                return credits >= getUnlockCost();
111        }
112        
113        public String getDialogText(CoreUIAPI ui) {
114                if (canPlayerAffordUnlock()) {
115                        return "Gaining access to storage at this colony requires a one-time fee of " + getUnlockCost() + " credits.";
116                } else {
117                        return "Gaining access to storage at this colony requires a one-time fee of " + getUnlockCost() + " credits, which you can't afford.";
118                }
119        }
120        public Highlights getDialogTextHighlights(CoreUIAPI ui) {
121                Highlights h = new Highlights();
122                h.setText("" + getUnlockCost());
123                if (canPlayerAffordUnlock()) {
124                        h.setColors(Misc.getHighlightColor());
125                } else {
126                        h.setColors(Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
127                }
128                return h;
129        }
130        public DialogOption [] getDialogOptions(CoreUIAPI ui) {
131                if (canPlayerAffordUnlock()) {
132                        return new DialogOption [] {
133                                new DialogOption("Pay", new Script() {
134                                        public void run() {
135                                                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
136                                                playerFleet.getCargo().getCredits().subtract(getUnlockCost());
137                                                playerPaidToUnlock = true;
138                                        }
139                                }),
140                                new DialogOption("Never mind", null)
141                        };
142                } else {
143                        return new DialogOption [] {
144                                        new DialogOption("Never mind", null)
145                        };
146                }
147        }

169        @Override
170        protected void createTooltipAfterDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded) {
171                
172                if (!market.isInEconomy()) return;
173                
174                float opad = 10f;
175                float pad = 3f;
176                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
177                        tooltip.addPara(Misc.getTokenReplaced("$marketName is under your control, and there " +
178                                        "are no storage fees or expenses.", market.getPrimaryEntity()), opad); 
179                        return;
180                }
181                
182                float f = Misc.getStorageFeeFraction();
183                int percent = (int) (f * 100f);
184                
185                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
186                
187                if (!playerPaidToUnlock) {
188                        tooltip.addPara("Requires a one-time access fee of %s, and a monthly fee equal to %s of the " +
189                                        "base value of the items in storage.", opad, h, 
190                                        "" + getUnlockCost() + Strings.C, "" + percent + "%");
191                        return;
192                }
193                
194                int cargoCost = (int) (Misc.getStorageCargoValue(market) * f);
195                int shipCost = (int) (Misc.getStorageShipValue(market) * f);
196                
197                if (cargoCost + shipCost > 0) {
198                        //tooltip.beginGrid(150, 1);
199                        tooltip.addPara("Monthly fees and expenses (%s of base value of stored items):", opad, h, "" + percent + "%");
200                        tooltip.beginGridFlipped(300, 1, 80, 10);
201                        int j = 0;
202                        tooltip.addToGrid(0, j++, "Ships in storage", Misc.getDGSCredits(shipCost));
203                        tooltip.addToGrid(0, j++, "Cargo in storage", Misc.getDGSCredits(cargoCost));
204                        tooltip.addGrid(pad);
205                } else {
206                        tooltip.addPara("Monthly fees and expenses are equal to %s of base value of the stored items.", opad, h, "" + percent + "%");
207                }
208        }
